text:
alex_m: Pager fired for embedder tail latency spike, customers seeing intermittent timeouts.
incident-bot: SEV2 pager triggered at 2026-03-12T21:05Z — incident: embed-queue-tail-latency; affected pods: embedder-0..3.
sasha_oncall: I'm on the page. initial mitigation: scaled replicas +2 and moved traffic to swapbox nodes to offload hot shard. @priya_sre can you check KV cache evictions?
priya_sre: Looking now — eviction rate jumped at 21:02, hit rate dropped ~20%. Bumping conservative TTL to 60s as a short-term fix, monitoring.
mike_pm: Customer impact numbers? need feed for comms and remediation prioritization.
jenna_support: From dashboards: ~4% of requests returned 504/timeout between 21:03-21:10. Top affected tenants: tenant-A, tenant-C. No billing-affecting data loss.
sasha_oncall: Mitigation holding, latencies back to baseline by 21:13. Moving to post-incident flow.
alex_m: Let's create concise action items: 1) Root-cause deep-dive (KV eviction profiling) — owner @priya_sre, size 3d. 2) Autoscale/backpressure policy improvement — owner @eng-runtime, size 5d. 3) Postmortem + customer comms — owner @mike_pm, size 1d.
priya_sre: Agree with sizes. Add 4) Load test eviction scenario to reproduce — owner @sasha_oncall, size 2d.
mike_pm: Prioritization: RC dive = high (P0->fix), autoscale = medium, load-test = low. Tie autoscale & telemetry work into Q2 reliability OKR.
sasha_oncall: Propose postmortem: Tue 2026-03-16 15:00 PT (30m). I'll draft timeline and initial notes.
incident-bot: Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-16T22:00Z in #incidents. Postmortem doc stub: /docs/postmortems/3344556677-embed-tail.json
jenna_support: I'll draft customer-safe comms. If impact >2% errors, mark comms as P0. Assigning to myself, estimate 0.5d.
alex_m: For consistency, use points where 1pt = 0.5d. So 3d = 6pt, 5d = 10pt, etc. Add all tickets to Jira epic "Q2 inference reliability".
priya_sre: Also need telemetry refinement: per-tenant error ratios and per-shard eviction metrics. Owner @obs-team, estimate 4d.
mike_pm: Final owners + sizes: RC investigation @priya_sre (6pt), autoscale @eng-runtime (10pt), load test @sasha_oncall (4pt), comms @jenna_support (1pt), telemetry @obs-team (8pt). Prioritize RC + comms for immediate sprint.
sasha_oncall: I'll open tickets and tag owners now; will include links to logs and initial mitigation timeline.
sasha_oncall: Tickets opened: INF-3421 (RC), INF-3422 (autoscale + rollback playbook), INF-3423 (load-test), INF-3424 (customer-comms), INF-3425 (telemetry). Estimates and Q2 epic linked.
alex_m: Nice. One more: include rollback playbook steps (embedder rollback, traffic-shift commands) into INF-3422, add +1d for runbook + verification.
priya_sre: Noted, I'll add rollback checklist and quick commands snippet to the ticket.
mike_pm: We'll review action item progress at Monday's triage and re-prioritize into next sprint if needed. Good mitigation and handoff, team :thumbsup:
